desc:
✨ Welcome to Anime Idol Life! ✨

Become your favorite idols, collect fun skins using yen, 
and meet new friends as you explore a colorful, growing world! 🎶🗺️

The game is still super new (Alpha!) — we’re always adding more updates, 
idols, skins, and surprises! 💖 Start your journey today and be part of the beginning! 🌟
